title: Arcade: Brick Blitz
description: A Breakout-inspired browser arcade game. It focuses on fast reactions, satisfying rebounds, and chasing a highscore.
excerpt: Break bricks and try to beat your own highscore.

page.tagline: Smash through the wall of bricks and keep the ball alive.
page.intro: Take on a fast-paced brick breaker challenge in this browser arcade game. Clear the bricks and see how long you can stay alive.

metadata.instructions: Use the on-screen menu to start, pause or restart. Move the paddle with the arrow keys, mouse or touch; keep the ball in play and clear the bricks. Sound is optional.
